entries.title: Outlast
entries.definitive_edition: Outlast plus Whistleblower DLC on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with the Whistleblower DLC installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with capture/settings flexibility.

primary.version: Outlast plus Whistleblower DLC on Steam
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best main playthrough because it has the complete base game, PC capture/settings flexibility, and direct access to the Whistleblower story DLC that overlaps with and extends the original game's plot.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Outlast and the Whistleblower DLC on Steam, or use the Outlast Trinity Steam bundle, and play the Windows PC build with Whistleblower after the base campaign.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with settings and capture flexibility; Whistleblower DLC is available on the same route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity complete route when paired with the Whistleblower DLC.
skip: no sourced exclusive content, and the PC route offers better capture/settings flexibility.
skip: no sourced exclusive content, and the PC route offers better capture/settings flexibility.
skip: useful platform support, but no content advantage over the Windows PC primary.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable Switch release that includes Outlast and Whistleblower.
all_releases.reason: skip: includes the DLC, but no sourced exclusive content and lower fidelity/capture priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The key extra story content is Whistleblower DLC, which is available on the PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster is required; Outlast Trinity is a bundle rather than a new version of the first game.

entries.title: Outlast 2

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with capture/settings flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the same full game with PC capture/settings flexibility, and Outlast 2 has no DLC campaign that would force a separate completeness route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Outlast 2 on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check for any display or compatibility notes before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with settings and capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route for the complete game.
skip: same base game, no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster or DLC-complete edition is documented for Outlast 2.

entries.title: The Outlast Trials

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and current patch.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC Unreal Engine 4 presentation with current live-service content.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best main route because it supports solo or co-op play, has PC capture/settings flexibility, and launched alongside the same 1.0 content family as the console versions.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Outlast Trials on Steam for Windows PC. For co-op, keep the game updated and use the official cross-play support if playing with console friends.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with settings and capture flexibility; early access began on PC before the 1.0 launch.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture/fidelity route for the live-service Outlast prequel.
skip: same core game family and cross-play support, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: same core game family and cross-play support, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed; cross-play keeps co-op platform choice flexible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content changes over time; keep the PC build updated before streaming.
